other_conditions: Startup must be certified by the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC) and have a valid start‑up certificate number.
The product for which the benefit is claimed must not have been previously available in the market.
Only digital payments made after the Goa Start‑up Policy 2017 notification are eligible for reimbursement.
Applications should be submitted at least 1–3 months before product launch.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 25% matching funds (maximum ₹2,500,000) to eligible startups, payable within 60 days of approval.
